config.name: Push to Prep Knight
config.note: If your server runs on a different host/port, update the URL accordingly. For Docker n8n talking to host machine use: http://host.docker.internal:3000/api/ingest

final_step.connect: Connect output of 'Parse Claude + Gate (score >= 6)' → 'Push to Prep Knight'

variables_required.LINKEDIN_RSS_URL: Your LinkedIn saved search RSS URL
variables_required.NAUKRI_RSS_URL: Your Naukri saved search RSS URL
variables_required.GSHEET_DOC_ID: Google Sheet document ID from the URL
variables_required.CANDIDATE_PROFILE: 5+ years PM experience, led 0-to-1 products, B2B SaaS background
variables_required.KEY_SKILLS: product strategy, roadmap, stakeholder management, OKRs, data analytics, agile

credentials_required: Anthropic API — your Claude API key (used by Claude Score & Filter node)
Google Sheets OAuth2 — connect your Google account (used by sheet read/write nodes)

name: The Prep Knight — Autonomous Quest Pipeline

nodes.name: LinkedIn RSS Feed
nodes.notes: Set LINKEDIN_RSS_URL in n8n Variables. Get it by saving a LinkedIn job search and appending &format=rss to the URL.

nodes.name: Naukri RSS Feed
nodes.notes: Set NAUKRI_RSS_URL in n8n Variables. From Naukri saved search > Share > RSS link.

nodes.name: Push to Prep Knight
nodes.notes: Pushes scored jobs directly to the dashboard in real-time via POST /api/ingest. For Docker: use http://host.docker.internal:3000/api/ingest
